description: Bornes de recharge pour is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Brest métropole. Charging stations for electric vehicles Thematic Energy Producer Brest metropolis Creator Mobilities Directorate Detailed sheet INSPIRE Id ENECONBornesElec Type points Ladder 10000 Territory Finistry. Coverage: Brest métropole. The portal shows the English title as "Charging stations for electric vehicles" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Brest métropole. Its keywords include automobiles, electriques, recharges, bornes, voitures, energie. The listing shows 2 download or service links in ARCGIS, SHP. The listing shows 2026-07-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
